data.name: AllUnloaded
data.value: Nothing to build: every project is unloaded
data.comment: Why Build has nothing to build.

data.name: Doing
data.comment: A build under way (a build, rebuild, clean or publish) of what it builds.

data.name: Stopped
data.value: {kind, select, rebuild {Rebuild stopped} clean {Clean stopped} publish {Publish stopped} other {Build stopped}}
data.comment: A build (a build, rebuild, clean or publish) stopped.

data.name: Succeeded
data.value: {kind, select, rebuild {Rebuild succeeded} clean {Clean succeeded} publish {Publish succeeded} other {Build succeeded}}
data.comment: A build (a build, rebuild, clean or publish) that succeeded.

data.name: SucceededWarned
data.value: {kind, select, rebuild {Rebuild succeeded with {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}} clean {Clean succeeded with {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}} publish {Publish succeeded with {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}} other {Build succeeded with {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}}}
data.comment: A build that succeeded, with how many warnings it gave.

data.name: FailedBecause
data.value: {kind, select, rebuild {Rebuild failed: {why}} clean {Clean failed: {why}} publish {Publish failed: {why}} other {Build failed: {why}}}
data.comment: A build that failed, and the SDK's words why.

data.name: FailedListed
data.value: {kind, select, rebuild {Rebuild failed: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; Problems lists them} clean {Clean failed: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; Problems lists them} publish {Publish failed: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; Problems lists them} other {Build failed: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; Problems lists them}}
data.comment: A build that failed, with its errors and warnings, which Problems lists.

data.name: FailedEnded
data.value: {kind, select, rebuild {Rebuild failed: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; dotnet ended with {exit}, the Build window says why} clean {Clean failed: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; dotnet ended with {exit}, the Build window says why} publish {Publish failed: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; dotnet ended with {exit}, the Build window says why} other {Build failed: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; dotnet ended with {exit}, the Build window says why}}
data.comment: A build that failed with no error to list: how dotnet ended ({exit}, as "exit code 1").

data.name: FailedInListed
data.value: {kind, select, rebuild {Rebuild failed in {projects}: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; Problems lists them} clean {Clean failed in {projects}: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; Problems lists them} publish {Publish failed in {projects}: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; Problems lists them} other {Build failed in {projects}: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; Problems lists them}}
data.comment: A build of several projects side by side that failed, the projects whose errors it named, with its errors and warnings.

data.name: FailedInEnded
data.value: {kind, select, rebuild {Rebuild failed in {projects}: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; dotnet ended with {exit}, the Build window says why} clean {Clean failed in {projects}: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; dotnet ended with {exit}, the Build window says why} publish {Publish failed in {projects}: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; dotnet ended with {exit}, the Build window says why} other {Build failed in {projects}: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}; dotnet ended with {exit}, the Build window says why}}
data.comment: A build of several projects side by side that failed with no error to list, and how dotnet ended.

data.name: WaitingForDesignTime
data.value: Waiting for the design-time build of {project} to end…
data.comment: A build waiting for the design-time build of a project, which writes what it would write.

data.name: WaitingForDesignTimes
data.value: {count, plural, one {Waiting for the design-time builds of # project to end…} other {Waiting for the design-time builds of # projects to end…}}
data.comment: A build waiting for the design-time builds of several projects.

data.name: WaitingForBuild
data.value: Waiting for the build under way to end…
data.comment: A start's build waiting for the build under way.

data.name: UpToDate
data.value: {project} is up to date: nothing its build reads has changed since it was built, so it was not built again
data.comment: A start that did not build its project, which stands as last built.

data.name: AllUpToDate
data.value: {projects} are up to date: nothing their builds read has changed since they were built, so they were not built again
data.comment: A start that built none of its projects, each standing as last built.

data.name: OpenFolderIn
data.comment: What a click on a publish's words in the status bar does, after "Click to": the folder it published to shown in the file manager (Finder, Explorer).

data.name: OpenFile
data.comment: What a click on a failed build's words in the status bar does, after "Click to": the file that chose the SDK opened.

data.name: ReadingPublish
data.comment: A publish reading the project's profile for where and how it publishes.

data.name: LookingForLogin
data.comment: A container publish looking for a login the SDK would find for the registry it pushes to.

data.name: AskingForLogin
data.value: Asking {registry} whether it wants a login…
data.comment: A container publish asking the registry whether a push needs a login.

data.name: NotPushed
data.comment: A container publish refused before it started: the registry wants a login none was found for.

data.name: NotIntoEngine
data.value: {what} cannot be published into the engine: {why}
data.comment: A container publish into this machine's engine, refused as the engine cannot take it, and why.

data.name: RunningStep
data.comment: An AppHost's deploy step running.

data.name: PublishingThrough
data.comment: An AppHost published through its own publishers (Docker Compose's, Kubernetes').

data.name: LookingForNeeds
data.comment: An AppHost's deploy step looking for the logins and the engine it needs.

data.name: StepNotRun
data.comment: An AppHost's deploy step refused, and what it needs that is missing ("needs a login to Azure").

data.name: CannotPublish
data.comment: An AppHost's publish that could not start, and why.

data.name: NoImage
data.comment: A container publish whose build made no image, and the SDK's warning why.

data.name: NoImageSaid
data.value: {what} made no image: the Build window says why
data.comment: A container publish whose build made no image, with no warning to say why.

data.name: PublishedIntoEngine
data.value: Published {what} as the {images, plural, one {image} other {images}} {image}, into the engine
data.comment: A container publish into this machine's engine, the images it made named.

data.name: PublishedPushed
data.value: Published {what}: pushed the {images, plural, one {image} other {images}} {image}
data.comment: A container publish pushed to a registry, the images it pushed named.

data.name: Published
data.comment: A publish that succeeded.

data.name: PublishedTo
data.comment: A publish that succeeded, and the folder it published to.

data.name: WithWarnings
data.value: {said} with {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}
data.comment: A build or publish that succeeded ({said}, as "Published Api to bin/publish"), with how many warnings it gave.

data.name: WritingFiles
data.comment: An AppHost's publish putting the files its publishers wrote into the folder chosen.

data.name: FilesUnwritten
data.value: {name} published, but its files were not written to {folder}: {why}
data.comment: An AppHost's publish whose files could not be put into the folder chosen.

data.name: RanStep
data.comment: An AppHost's deploy step that ran.

data.name: NothingWritten
data.value: {name}'s publishers wrote nothing: its code adds none (AddDockerComposeEnvironment adds Docker Compose's)
data.comment: An AppHost's publish that wrote no files, as its code adds no publisher.

data.name: RanStepWrote
data.value: Ran {step} of {name}, its files written to {folder}: {files}
data.comment: An AppHost's deploy step that ran, and the files it wrote.

data.name: PublishedFiles
data.comment: An AppHost's publish, and the files its publishers wrote.

data.name: Restoring
data.comment: A publish restoring the project's packages.

data.name: MakingImage
data.comment: A container publish making its image.

data.name: ImageInEngine
data.value: Publishing {what}: its image is in the engine
data.comment: A container publish whose image is in this machine's engine.

data.name: ImagePushed
data.comment: A container publish whose image is pushed to its registry.

data.name: PublishersWriting
data.comment: An AppHost's publish whose publishers are writing its files.

data.name: CopyingForImage
data.value: Publishing {what}: copying it to its folder for its image…
data.comment: A container publish copying the app to its folder for its image.

data.name: Copying
data.value: Publishing {what}: copying it to its folder…
data.comment: A publish copying the app to its folder.

data.name: NoPresets
data.value: {folder} has no {file}: make an export preset in Godot's editor (Project, Export)
data.comment: A Godot export refused: the game's folder has no export_presets.cfg.

data.name: NoPreset
data.comment: A Godot export refused: export_presets.cfg has no preset of the name asked, and the presets it has.

data.name: PresetNamesNoFile
data.value: The preset {preset} names no file to export to (its export_path): give one, or set it in Godot's editor (Project, Export)
data.comment: A Godot export refused: its preset names no file to export to.

data.name: CannotExport
data.comment: A Godot export refused, and why.

data.name: ReadingExport
data.comment: A Godot export reading its preset and the Godot that exports it.

data.name: TemplatesMissing
data.value: {preset} cannot be exported: Godot {version} has no {missing} among its export templates: install them from a {archive} in Publish
data.comment: A Godot export refused: the Godot that exports lacks the export templates it needs, and how to install them.

data.name: TemplatesMissingIn
data.value: {preset} cannot be exported: Godot {version} has no {missing} among its export templates ({folder}): install them from a {archive} in Publish
data.comment: A Godot export refused: the Godot that exports lacks export templates in its templates' folder, and how to install them.

data.name: ExportStopped
data.comment: A Godot export stopped before Godot started.

data.name: FolderUnmade
data.comment: A Godot export whose output folder could not be made.

data.name: Exporting
data.value: {kind, select, debug {Exporting {preset}, a debug export…} other {Exporting {preset}, a release export…}}
data.comment: A Godot export under way, a debug or a release export.

data.name: ExportingWith
data.comment: A Godot export begun, and the Godot that exports.

data.name: ExportStage
data.comment: A Godot export under way: what Godot says it is doing, and how much of it is done.

data.name: ExportOfStopped
data.comment: A Godot export stopped.

data.name: Exported
data.comment: A Godot export that wrote the game.

data.name: GodotWroteNothing
data.comment: How a Godot export failed: Godot ended well but wrote no game.

data.name: ExportFailed
data.comment: A Godot export that failed, and how Godot ended ({ended}, as "exit code 1").

data.name: ExportFailedSaying
data.comment: A Godot export that failed, how Godot ended, and the first error Godot said.
